description: MarketWatch quote for one stock, ETF/fund or index ticker (symbol, e.g. AAPL; type stock, fund or index, default stock): name, exchange, currency, last price, change and change %, quote time, plus the Key Data panel (open, day range, 52-week range, market cap, shares outstanding, float, beta, P/E, EPS, yield, dividend, ex-dividend date, short interest, average volume). Prices may be delayed. Use it when you need the valuation and dividend figures for one ticker in one call; it gives the current quote only, not price history. An unknown ticker returns 404 and is not charged. Price: $0.004 per successful call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana and 10 more networks); failed calls are not charged.

type.description: stock, fund or index (default stock; use fund for ETFs/mutual funds)
